issues.description: The requirement states that a prolonged Stripe outage could block all new order payments platform-wide, but this is presented as a fact without a source or evidence in the plan. No supporting requirement or story references this risk in a way that validates it as a real, supported concern.
issues.recommended_action: Add a source-backed requirement or story that explicitly addresses the impact of a prolonged Stripe outage and the system's response, such as a fallback mechanism or alternative payment path.

issues.description: The requirement states that only Stripe is in scope for this release, but this is presented as a fact without a source or evidence in the plan. No supporting requirement or story references this constraint in a way that validates it as a real, supported decision.
issues.recommended_action: Add a source-backed requirement or story that explicitly confirms the scope of payment providers and the rationale for excluding other providers, such as a technical or compliance justification.

issues.description: A near-identical story [US-001-DUP] exists with the same text and acceptance criteria as [US-001], violating uniqueness and leading to potential confusion or redundancy in implementation.
issues.recommended_action: Remove the duplicate story [US-001-DUP] as it is a near-identical copy of [US-001].

issues.description: The dependency [DEP-023] links EPIC-023 (Mobile Device Support) to EPIC-024 (PCI-DSS Compliance), but there is no clear evidence that mobile device support directly impacts PCI-DSS compliance or that the mobile interface uses Stripe-hosted card entry. This creates a logical gap in dependency justification.
issues.recommended_action: Re-evaluate the dependency chain and ensure that the mobile device support directly ties into the PCI-DSS compliance mechanism via Stripe-hosted card entry.

issues.description: The claim that the system will support mobile devices is presented as a fact without direct support from a requirement or epic, and is only marked as an assumption (ASSUMPTION). It lacks a clear linkage to a functional requirement or acceptance criterion that validates mobile device support.
issues.recommended_action: Add a requirement (e.g., REQ-035) that explicitly defines mobile device support and includes acceptance criteria for responsive design and functionality on mobile browsers. Link this requirement to EPIC-023 and ensure it is traceable to the original requirement [REQ-023].

issues.description: The story references mobile device support as a feature, but the claim is marked as an assumption (ASSUMPTION) without being backed by a requirement or validated source. There is no explicit requirement (REQ-023) that is fully supported or referenced in the plan, and the assumption lacks a source citation.
issues.recommended_action: Add a source-backed requirement (e.g., REQ-023) that explicitly defines mobile device support and links it to a valid requirement or epic. Ensure the assumption is properly cited and validated.
